stories.headline: About 120 kg of cocaine and a handgun found in a Long Island City high-rise apartment; two men face federal conspiracy charges
stories.body: Announced on 9 November by the Southern District of New York and the DEA, the case centres on a Queens apartment leased by Glen Contreras where agents executed a search warrant. Contreras and Erick Marcano are each charged with conspiring to distribute five kilograms or more of cocaine, following an investigation that reportedly began in August 2026. The charges are allegations.
